_doc: MKK costs and income per year, in Ft, for the budget slide charts (src/charts.py). Costs: xcontest (XContest fee), kupak (cups, medals, gift cards). Income: siresz (SIRESZ Sportalap, total, before 2022), siresz_cel (SIRESZ Sportalap céltámogatás: the pilots' voluntary MKK payments), siresz_alt (SIRESZ Sportalap general, covers the rest), hffa, sarkany (Sárkányrepülésért Alapítvány). Every value is verified unless its key is in 'estimate' (from webshop prices, no invoice yet), 'digitized' (read off the old 2025 chart image) or 'derived' (siresz_alt = costs minus the other income: SIRESZ Sportalap always covers the rest of the year; computed by charts.py, not stored). 'unsure': segments drawn with a red frame on the charts (not certain). 'missing': unknown values. XContest at the ECB rate of the invoice date counts as exact. Server costs (starthelyek.hu) and SVB fuel are not MKK costs (user, 2026-11-20). XContest in Ft: the EUR invoice × the ECB rate on the invoice date (user, 2026-11-20); there is no forint debit.
